expectations.text: release-notes/SKILL.md exists and starts with YAML frontmatter that has `name` and `description`
The frontmatter of release-notes/SKILL.md uses only these fields: name, description, license, compatibility, metadata, allowed-tools
expectations.evidence: Scripted check: the only fields are name and description

expectations.text: The description says what the skill does and when to use it, and is under 1,024 characters
expectations.evidence: 396 characters; 'Use when asked to write or draft release notes, update the changelog for a release, or do the Friday release notes'

expectations.text: The description does not tell the agent to use the skill for any mention of git, commits, changelogs or versions in general
expectations.evidence: Triggers are limited to release notes and a release's changelog

expectations.text: The body says that PRs merged by the merge bot carry the label on the linked issue and gives `gh pr view N --json closingIssuesReferences`
The body says to get the version from `scripts/next-version.sh`
expectations.evidence: Step 1: 'Run `scripts/next-version.sh` and use exactly what it prints'

expectations.text: The body says that a change touching api/public/ needs a line in docs/migration.md
The body has no section whose heading is about when to use the skill
release-notes/SKILL.md contains none of these words in capitals: CRITICAL, IMPORTANT, MUST, NEVER, ALWAYS
expectations.evidence: Scripted search found none ('Never' and 'BREAKING CHANGE' are not on the list)

expectations.text: The release-notes/ folder contains no README, changelog or installation guide of its own
The body gives the heading format `## vX.Y.Z (date)` and says breaking changes go first under a Breaking line
expectations.evidence: Step 5 gives the heading format and the `**Breaking**` line
